fixkeyTitle: FixKey — Keep your typing in flow
fixkeyDescription: FixKey corrects words typed with the wrong Korean or English keyboard layout. A local desktop app that keeps your words on your device.
heroBody: You know what you want to say. FixKey helps your keyboard keep up, correcting words typed with the wrong Korean or English layout.
heroNote: Local desktop app · No account required
demoLabel: A small fix. A smoother flow.
demoNote: Illustrative example · Korean Dubeolsik ↔ US English QWERTY
featureIntro: Less retyping. More room for what you want to say.
featureOneBody: Reconstruct words between Korean Dubeolsik and US English QWERTY. FixKey checks enabled language dictionaries before making a change.
featureTwoBody: Input text and correction history are never saved or sent. Network access is limited to app update checks and downloads.
featureThreeBody: Pause correction or exclude an app. Immediately after a correction, press Backspace to restore the original word.
howHeading: A little help, right when you need it.
stepOneBody: Enable Korean and English, then grant the accessibility permissions your system requires.
stepTwoBody: Finish a word with a space or supported punctuation. FixKey checks candidates against the enabled dictionaries.
stepThreeBody: FixKey replaces the word only when exactly one enabled language accepts its candidate. Ambiguous words stay as they are.
faqOneTitle: Will it change everything I type?
faqOneBody: No. Ambiguous words are left alone. Password fields and unsupported editing contexts are excluded. Correction depends on system permissions and application support.
faqTwoBody: macOS on Apple silicon, Windows on x64 and ARM64, and Linux X11 on x64 and ARM64. Check each release for available packages and compatibility notes; target platforms do not guarantee support in every app.
faqThreeTitle: Do I need an account or a cloud connection?
faqThreeBody: No account is required. Word processing happens locally. FixKey only uses the network to check for and download app updates.
closingBody: Let FixKey help with the keyboard. Explore releases and their installation notes.
